item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 29/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring hot weather and showers to Guangdong in the next couple of days. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, showers will increase gradually with thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. A southwesterly airstream will bring hot weather to the coastal areas of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
